the markers named in the agent are exactly the ones the renderer writes, and the agent has the Read tool
every code-reviewer spawn site hands the reviewer its project root

the changelog pilot P1 plan links the guide section by a relative anchor that resolves
a real render of the shipwright-monorepo profile gives one block whose begin line names the profile; a duplicated block makes render --check refuse with exit 3
